notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 asynchronous-delivery and callback-servicing surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies enable/disable boundaries, receive-order callback gating, explicit callback servicing, and time-advance release without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador asynchronous-delivery and callback-evocation services with FederateAmbassador receive and time-role callbacks
